mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over Fireman's Park and a beautiful First Quarter moon, though there are no visible ISS flyovers for our area tonight.

The City of Verona keeps you connected through the VHAT cable channel and the official city blog, where you can find council meeting recordings and important community resources. You can also sign up for the digital newsletter to stay updated on city projects and programs.

We have plenty to look forward to today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, we also have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie tomorrow, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market this Friday.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 13, an officer assisted after a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became stuck on a large rock.
You are in for a delight with today's flavor, Really Reese's. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, get ready for the Chocolate Volcano.
